title: 今回だけはどうしても

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A philosopher in the Middle Ages once said:

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Do not be led astray by the voices of those around you. Do not identify yourself with idols as you advance."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Do not identify with idols…"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O… I wanted to talk with you about the autumn Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Looking at the number of slots, it seems like the girl who won the NHK Mile Cup won't be able to run…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Is that right? Don't let it faze you. It matters little who runs or who doesn't.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: For I will be the lead at the autumn Tenno Sho! I will be the antagonist and the director! And you will also be present!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Which is to say… she always has next year.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall not be disturbed by any turn of events. I shall simply continue down the path of the Overlord! For this is the Twinkle Series, and it affords no other means by which I may claim my throne!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: News of the racer in question makes its way to Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So… this is how it is. After she worked so hard in the Kobe Shimbun Hai too…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: She couldn't make it… even though she tried her hardest…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This sucks… This is the worst I've felt since I debuted…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I never had to deal with anything like this before I began running myself… I could just innocently simp…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I lived as if I was in a dream watching Umamusume happily run through paradise…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I never knew that the tears of those angels amassed beneath the sand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And now it's come to this… I can't have my chance to shine without stealing someone else's.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The dead end of a dead end! How am I expected to go into the autumn Tenno Sho feeling like this?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I should have just never debuted at all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If I'd just kept waffling between turf and dirt forever, this never would've happened! Never…
choice_data_list: None of the good things would have happened either, though. Right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Do you really think you were better off ignorant?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I… No… I wasn't… Of course I wasn't.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I discovered the extraordinary thing Umamusume clasp onto at the end of their struggles.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Winning and losing… That's what racing is all about. And if there are winners, there have to be losers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Someone always walks away sad no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But that regret turns into motivation for tomorrow! I didn't know it before, but now I've experienced it firsthand!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's why I can say from the bottom of my heart that all the Umamusume in the Twinkle Series are amazing! I love them all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They stay persistent, beaming as they burst through every obstacle no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's why I will do it too one day! AND SHE WILL TOO!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Oh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her outburst, Agnes Digital suddenly comes to.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: She'll definitely… do it too… What happened this time isn't about winning or losing, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's more like… overcoming hardship? If that determination is what makes Umamusume so precious…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Then she'll probably overcome this too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Maybe one day she'll realize that this is just another test that will make her stronger.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You… really think so? I feel like… if she can do it, then…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Then so can I. I'm Agnes Digital the All-Rounder, and I'm gonna run in every race I possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll take the determination King taught me and use it to pass forth the torch of courage, just like I swore I would!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I have to give that Uma inspiration. That's why…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll race in the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But I'm not just gonna run! That's definitely not enough!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win so spectacularly that she won't have a single regret about missing it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I want it to be so great that it makes her want to run there next year. Like sooo well that it'll drive her to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely do it! Definitely, definitely, definitely!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's my responsibility if I'm going to run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital sets her resolve for the coming race. However, T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto won't be easy opponents.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Long, long ago, a wise philosopher once said…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Don't be led astray by the crowd. And especially don't spend so long in it that you can't move past it."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can't help but identify with them! I feel their emotions as if they were my own and weep!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's what I do! That's how deep my love for Umamusume runs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I won't go forward pretending like there aren't any Umas feeling disappointed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Instead, I'll take their sadness as my own and carry it into all the races I run. Their tears will be my power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And even if it's not enough, I'll…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll take the feelings of every Umamusume that I've come across and throw it all at the Overlord and Doto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her love for Umamusume is her strength. The grief she carried just moments ago has become her secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We need to use this drive to keep chasing the two peaks looming ahead of us until the day of the race.
